request_fields: task prompt (paper Table 8: summarise hospitalization in <=200 words) + instruct (discharge-summary text, prefixed "Input:")
notes: Benchmark exists only as part of the ClinicBench release (Liu et al., EMNLP 2024; ClinicBench is the suite and the own release). Prompt text per task is in Table 8 of the paper (https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.759.pdf); the release ships items without the prompt. 382 items, matches the 382 in Table 1. Items are MIMIC-IV discharge notes (hadm_id/subject_id retained, "___" de-identification). They download from GitHub without credentials, so public=yes on the criterion as written, but redistribution of MIMIC-IV text is outside the PhysioNet DUA; flag for a decision. Inputs are long (median ~10k characters). Checked 2026-10-04; no LLMs or API keys used.
